result.markdown:
Curated prompt galleries, code-to-image test suites, and output examples for **ChatGPT Images 2.6** (including its **Flare** and **Sunburst** modes, GIF animation workflows, and layer-edit controls) can be found across several active design and technical blogs:[pexo.ai](https://pexo.ai/model/chatgpt-images-2-6#:~:text=Core%20capabilities%20*%20Flare%20example.%20Sunburst%20example.,option%20to%20test%20for%20more%20demanding%20detail.)

* **MetricsMule (ChatGPT Images 2.6 Prompts):** Features a structured set of copy-and-paste prompt galleries ranging from creative macro photography and typography experiments to step-by-step sprite sheet outputs and looping sequences.
* **each::labs Blog:** Publishes technical teardowns with live run-tests on both Flare and Sunburst modes, detailing exact parameters for stickers, character turnaround sheets, and clean edit-chains.
* **Pexo AI Model Guides:** Offers visual breakdown directories comparing how complexity controls and rendering tiers behave under version 2.6, alongside guidance for multi-step creative assets.[pexo.ai](https://pexo.ai/model/chatgpt-images-2-6#:~:text=Separate%20scene%20planning%20from%20visual%20detail.%20Complexity,keep%20the%20version%20that%20meets%20your%20brief.)
* **KreadoAI Prompt Guides:** Provides deep-dive application examples focusing heavily on product pack-shots, strict typography hierarchy, and "keep-list" regional image editing workflows.
